observations.text: The consumer generator is a single-prompt form with a compact config chip and progressive popovers; 图片/视频/数字人/动作模仿 are radio modes of the same page (<title> 图片视频生成器).

Parameter disclosure: tier 1 = prompt + model chip + config chip; tier 2 = config popover (quality, resolution, ratio, count / duration, audio). No 'advanced' section on liblib.art; sampler-level controls exist only in the /sd WebUI surface.

Community → generation link: image detail 做同款 opens /ai-tool/image-generator?fillimgid=<imageId> (prefills the generator from a published image); the model detail page's primary CTA is 去WebUI使用 (LoRA routed to the SD WebUI, not this generator).
Model picker exposes capability badges per model (多参考图, 超清4K, 组图模式, 指令编辑强, 风格模型) — capability-based disclosure rather than raw parameters.
Video prompt supports inline @ references to attached 图片/视频/音频 (same @-mention idiom as the LibTV canvas).
Job lifecycle on liblib.art was not exercised: credits were 0 (积分 0) and an Aliyun CAPTCHA widget is mounted on the page; no generation was submitted.
